description: This file defines the AuthApiService class which implements authentication-related API calls such as generating recovery codes, retrieving recovery key parameters, and signing in with recovery codes. It manages ongoing operations and handles errors.

classes.name: AuthApiService
classes.description: Implements authentication API methods, manages operation states, and handles errors for auth-related server interactions.

methods.name: generateRecoveryCodes
methods.description: Requests the server to generate recovery codes, managing operation state and error handling.

methods.name: recoveryKeyParams
methods.description: Retrieves recovery key parameters from the server using provided user data.

methods.name: signInWithRecoveryCodes
methods.description: Performs sign-in using recovery codes, handling operation state and errors.
